patch.summary: Capsule migration guide: inventory → rehearse → freeze → validate integrations — grounded in researched limitations and catalogue peers.

blocks.body: Migrate to Capsule by inventorying legacy crm fields, mapping them to Capsule objects, rehearsing a freeze window, and validating Gmail, Outlook, QuickBooks before reopening writes.
bullets: Inventory → map → rehearse → cut over → reopen
Highest risk: Contact, pipeline, and custom-field limits scale strictly by plan tier.
Success signal: contact management works for the pilot cohort

blocks.heading: Capsule migration cutover playbook
blocks.body: Migrations fail from optimistic timelines — not from missing motivation.

scenarios.title: Field inventory
scenarios.body: Export legacy fields that power contact management, lead management, pipeline management and mark must-map vs archive.

scenarios.title: Rehearsal load
scenarios.body: Run a non-prod load into Capsule; measure match rates before the freeze.

scenarios.title: Production freeze
scenarios.body: Freeze legacy writes; cut over; validate Gmail; then reopen.

steps.label: Migrate when Small businesses wanting a simple CRM outweigh migration cost
Delay if this limitation hits cutover: Contact, pipeline, and custom-field limits scale strictly by plan tier.
If Capsule mapping is poor, compare destination fit with Streak before moving data twice

items.title: No freeze window
items.body: Dual-writing without a freeze creates irrevocable duplicates.

items.title: Integrations last
items.body: Wire Gmail in rehearsal — not on Monday morning after cutover.

items.title: Data risk 1
items.body: Contact, pipeline, and custom-field limits scale strictly by plan tier.

items.title: Data risk 2
items.body: Workflow automations and advanced reporting start at Growth; enrichment at Advanced.

items.title: Data risk 3
items.body: Not a marketing automation or sales-engagement suite — email templates ≠ full campaign platform.

checklist.label: Complete field inventory for contact management
Mitigate: Contact, pipeline, and custom-field limits scale strictly by plan tier.
